title: Strategic Repayment and Latent Fragility in Financial Networks: Why Banks Withhold Payable Liquidity
abstract: arXiv:2611.21262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A network in which every bank pays in full can nevertheless admit a self-fulfilling settlement freeze under the same balance-sheet fundamentals. Thus, observing full repayment does not establish the uniqueness or robustness of the payment equilibrium. We derive this result from a precautionary-liquidity choice: banks may delay otherwise feasible payments to insure an interim funding need, trading a positive settlement-discipline cost against the marginal value of retained cash. The optimal reserve is a critical quantile of future liquidity requirements, and the repayment rule nests Eisenberg-Noe maximal feasible clearing exactly. Counterparty underpayment both reduces current cash and raises desired reserves. We characterise network amplification and the conditions for coexistence, including a homogeneous two-bank GPD frontier in which interbank exposure and maximum funding pass-through enter through one dimensionless index. translated_title: 金融网络中的策略性偿还与潜在脆弱性：银行为何扣留本可支付的流动性
translated_abstract: 在相同的资产负债表基本面下，即使一个所有银行都能全额付款的网络，也可能出现自我实现的结算冻结。因此，观察到全额偿付并不能确立支付均衡的唯一性或稳健性。我们从预防性流动性选择中推导出这一结果：银行可能推迟原本可行的付款，以便为临时的资金需求提供保障，在正向的结算纪律成本与保留现金的边际价值之间进行权衡。最优储备是未来流动性需求的一个临界分位数，且该偿还规则恰好嵌套了Eisenberg-Noe最大可行清算。交易对手的少付既会减少当前现金，又会提高期望储备水平。我们刻画了网络放大效应以及多重均衡共存的条件，包括一个同质的两银行GPD边界，其中银行间敞口和最大资金传导通过一个无量纲指数进入。一个两期（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过引入银行的预防性流动性储备行为，证明了即使在所有银行都能全额还款的金融网络中，仍可能发生自我实现的结算冻结，从而表明观察到全额偿付并不能保证支付均衡的唯一性与稳健性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that banks' precautionary liquidity withholding—delaying otherwise feasible payments to insure against interim funding needs—can trigger self-fulfilling settlement freezes even in networks where every bank can repay in full, implying that observed full repayment does not establish uniqueness or robustness of the payment equilibrium.
